name: 2027 OneVoice State Priorities
note: Keywords are matched against each bill's short title and subjects, case-insensitive, as whole words. End a keyword with * to match any ending (psychiatr* matches psychiatric and psychiatry). A bill that also matches one of a priority's exclusion words is not counted for that priority. Edit them in the app's Agenda tab.

priorities.title: Implement Policies to Expedite Deployment of Critical Energy Infrastructure
priorities.summary: Streamline permitting and accelerate transmission lines and pipelines; coordinate with SPP rather than duplicative mandates; protect critical infrastructure from unauthorized drones.

priorities.title: Support an "All of the Above" Energy Strategy, Consumer Fuel Choice, and Expanded Energy Infrastructure
priorities.summary: Use all energy resources, preserve consumer fuel choice, avoid mandates favoring specific sources, expand transmission siting options.

priorities.title: Encourage Use of Existing Rights-of-Way for Infrastructure Development
priorities.summary: Site transmission lines, pipelines and other infrastructure in existing highway, utility and pipeline corridors to limit eminent domain.

priorities.title: Ensure Adequate Funding for Municipalities and Counties
priorities.summary: Protect and diversify municipal and county revenue beyond sales and property taxes; one-time funds for economic development projects such as levees.

priorities.title: Continue to Foster Healthy Partnership Between the 38 Federally Recognized Tribes and the State of Oklahoma
priorities.summary: Strengthen government-to-government partnerships with tribal nations.

priorities.title: Fund State Support for CMMC Compliance Among Oklahoma Manufacturers
priorities.summary: Fund a cost-shared Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification program and in-state assessment capacity.

priorities.title: Protect Oklahoma Medicaid Expansion
priorities.summary: Oppose any attempt to reduce, sunset or remove Medicaid expansion from the Oklahoma Constitution.

priorities.title: Address Oklahoma's Mental Health Treatment Needs
priorities.summary: Invest in mental health and addiction treatment, Medicaid reimbursement, CCBHCs, mental health workforce, Assertive Community Treatment and youth treatment.
keywords: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Services

priorities.title: Expand Health Care Workforce Opportunities
priorities.summary: Fund the Health Care Workforce Training Commission, residencies, loan repayment, behavioral health workforce fund and rural health workforce.

priorities.title: Create a Dedicated Funding Stream for Economic Development
priorities.summary: A permanent, dedicated funding source for economic development incentives, e.g. sports betting, settlement funds such as PFAS.

priorities.title: Invest in Oklahoma's Economic Competitiveness
priorities.summary: A coordinated, accountable incentive toolkit that protects local incentive programs; flexible, stackable tools; regular review of incentives.

priorities.title: Continue and Increase Investment in Site Readiness
priorities.summary: Continue and expand funding for site readiness so communities have shovel-ready sites with infrastructure, utilities and certifications.

priorities.title: Increase the Oklahoma Department of Tourism's Promotional Fund
priorities.summary: Increase funding for the Oklahoma Tourism and Recreation Department, building on the Route 66 Centennial.

priorities.title: Support Oklahoma's Film and Music Industries
priorities.summary: Protect and expand film and music incentives; raise the film incentive rebate cap to $80 million; incentives for music venues and artists.

priorities.title: Establish an Oklahoma Office of Outdoor Recreation
priorities.summary: Create an Office of Outdoor Recreation within an existing state entity.

priorities.title: Support Critically Needed Transportation Funding
priorities.summary: Fully fund ODOT's Eight-Year Plan and US-412 to I-42; oppose diverting the State Transportation Fund; support OTA's ACCESS Plan and oppose changes weakening OTA.
keywords: Rebuilding Oklahoma Access and Driver Safety

priorities.title: Modernize, Connect and Broaden the Region's Industrial and Logistics Ecosystem
priorities.summary: Fund connections among Tulsa International Airport, Port of Catoosa, Robson Ranch/Fair Oaks, Port of Inola and MidAmerica Industrial Park; freight, rail, barge and air freight.

priorities.title: Strengthen Oklahoma's Aerospace, Defense and Space Economy
priorities.summary: Modernize economic development and workforce programs for aerospace, defense and space; Quality Jobs eligibility; Choose Aerospace; aerospace academy; Oklahoma Air & Space Port.

priorities.title: Strengthen Public Education and Early Literacy
priorities.summary: Competitive teacher pay, educator recruitment and retention, per-pupil funding, early learning; fully fund early literacy reforms and reading specialists.

priorities.title: Expand Supports for Working Families
priorities.summary: Child care capacity, before- and after-school and summer programs, transportation, nutrition, health services; reduce benefit cliffs; employer-supported solutions; caregivers.

priorities.title: Strengthen Accessible and Workforce Housing
priorities.summary: Strengthen the Oklahoma Housing Stability Program; coordinate with federal tax credits; streamline applications; revisit rural/urban allocation; increase housing supply.
